# DanGM (dangm.ca)

> DanGM is Dan, a personal GM car-buying consultant working inside Eagle Ridge GM (Eagle Ridge Chevrolet Buick GMC), 2595 Barnet Hwy, Coquitlam, BC V3E 1K9. Zero-pressure car buying, financing for every credit situation (including bankruptcy and consumer proposals), new-to-Canada and work-permit car financing, and trade-in appraisals. Serves Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Burnaby, New Westminster, Surrey and Vancouver. Phone: 604-735-1396. Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm.

Vehicles are sold and financed through Eagle Ridge Chevrolet Buick GMC, a licensed motor dealer in British Columbia. Inventory pages are regenerated every hour from the dealership's live feed.
